//: jsx is set here and NOT in tsconfig.base.json on purpose (M0-T8). The base sets
no jsx at all, because packages/* are framework-free and a jsx setting there would
silently allow a .tsx file into a package that must not have one. apps/web is the
single React workspace (docs/02 §3), so react-jsx is a per-workspace necessity and
the base may only ever be narrowed — never widened — by an extending config.
The exclude is `src/**/*.test.*` and not `src/**/*.test.ts`: a `.test.tsx` file
would slip past the narrower pattern and be typechecked by NOTHING — Vitest only
transpiles, and the build graph deliberately excludes tests. tsconfig.test.json
adds them back for the `pnpm typecheck` test pass.
